scripts.fcm:test: bun .github/scripts/send-fcm.ts --title="Test Notification" --body="This is a test notification from AnimeVsub" --type=general --topics=all_users --android_priority=high --android_color="#8B85FF"
scripts.fcm:test:image: bun .github/scripts/send-fcm.ts --title="Test with Image" --body="Check out this awesome notification with an image!" --type=feature --topics=all_users --image="https://picsum.photos/800/400?random=$(date +%s)" --android_priority=high --android_color="#8B85FF"
scripts.fcm:test:link: bun .github/scripts/send-fcm.ts --title="Open Link" --body="Tap to open a web page in your browser" --type=general --topics=all_users --deep_link="https://github.com/anime-vsub" --android_priority=high --android_color="#8B85FF"
scripts.fcm:token: bun .github/scripts/send-fcm.ts --title="Test Notification" --body="This is a test notification from AnimeVsub" --type=general --token=$FCM_TOKEN --android_priority=high --android_color="#8B85FF"
scripts.fcm:release: bun .github/scripts/send-fcm.ts --title="AnimeVsub Update" --body="A new version is available! Check settings to update." --type=app_update --deep_link=about --topics="all_users,app_updates" --android_priority=high --android_color="#8B85FF" --android_channel_id=system_notifications
